title: Artificial Intelligence in Equity and Crypto Markets: Progress, Profitability Evidence, and the Limits of Automated Investing
abstract: arXiv:2609.04917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) now supports investment workflows from data and prediction through research, portfolios, execution, and tool use. Technical capability, however, is not evidence of investment profitability. This critical state-of-the-art review examines public research available through 31 August 2026 on listed equities, exchange-traded funds, centralized crypto spot, perpetual futures, and on-chain markets. We organize evidence with an alpha-translation chain: point-in-time information must yield a stable signal, feasible positions, executable orders, and risk-adjusted returns after costs. Across machine learning, time-series foundation models, financial language models, reinforcement learning, and agents, the examined record shows real but mainly upstream progress in prediction, text processing, portfolio design, and workflow integration. translated_title: 人工智能在股票与加密货币市场中的应用：进展、盈利性证据与自动化投资的局限
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）如今已能够支持从数据与预测到研究、投资组合构建、交易执行以及工具使用的整个投资工作流程。然而，技术能力并不等同于投资盈利能力的证据。本批判性前沿综述考察了截至2026年8月31日可获取的公开研究，涵盖上市股票、交易所交易基金（ETF）、中心化加密货币现货、永续合约以及链上市场。我们采用“阿尔法传导链”框架来组织证据：时点信息必须能够转化为稳定的信号、可行的持仓、可执行的订单，以及扣除成本后的风险调整收益。纵观机器学习、时间序列基础模型、金融语言模型、强化学习与智能体等领域，所考察的研究记录显示，在预测、文本处理、投资组合设计和工作流整合方面确实取得了真实的进展，但这些进展主要集中在上游环节；而关于持久性净收益的证据则相对薄弱。时间性数据污染、重复选择……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本综述提出“阿尔法传导链”评估框架，系统梳理AI在股票与加密市场投资中的应用，发现AI在预测、文本处理与工作流整合等上游环节确有真实进展，但持久净收益的证据仍然薄弱。
en_tdlr: This critical review organizes AI investing evidence through an "alpha-translation chain" framework, finding genuine but mostly upstream progress in prediction, text processing, and workflow integration across equities and crypto markets, while evidence for durable risk-adjusted net performance remains thin.
